1.title: Your address
1.whyTitle: Right now, your customers are looking for you and can't find you.
1.whyBody: One in two customers who can't find a clear address calls the competitor next door. We're going to give you a link of your own, one you keep for life, that Google can finally read.
1.doneBody: It's yours. No one can ever take it from you — and the AI now knows how to write in your words.

2.title: What you sell
2.whyBody: A visitor decides in 8 seconds. If they see no price, no offer, no time slot, they leave. Let's fill up your storefront now — not "later".
2.doneTitle: Your customers know what to buy.
2.doneBody: A catalog, a featured offer, and real time slots. Your storefront can take a request while you're working.

3.title: Your visibility
3.whyTitle: The world's most beautiful storefront is useless if nobody walks by it.
3.whyBody: This is the step everyone skips — and it's exactly the one that fills up a schedule. Let's create your first piece of content and get your link out there.
3.doneBody: Your business is online, filled in, and shareable. Everything you add from here on out only widens the gap.

1.title: Create your storefront
1.gain: An address of your own, readable by Google, ready in 30 seconds.

2.title: Teach it to talk like you
2.gain: The AI stops writing like a robot and starts writing like you.

3.title: Create your product
3.gain: Without a visible price, one in two visitors leaves without contacting you.

4.title: Create your offers
4.gain: The featured offer is the first thing a customer sees. It's what makes them act.

5.title: Create your schedule
5.gain: Your customers book at night, on Sundays, while you're at work.

6.title: Create your first content
6.gain: Regular posts are what bring people back to your storefront.

7.title: Check your results
7.gain: What you don't measure, you can't improve.

8.title: Share your business everywhere
8.gain: The more your link circulates, the more your schedule fills up on its own.
